content: Migrated Nuvanta static page to src/pages/index.astro. Netlify Function netlify/functions/contact.mjs validates form submissions, appends to Google Sheets using service-account variables, and sends Telegram notification. Setup documented in README.md and .env.example; npm build passes with ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 in sandbox.

Refactored homepage into BaseLayout, global CSS, and section components: Header, Hero, TrustStrip, Services, CompliancePathway, Partnership, TrackRecord, WhyNuvanta, ContactSection, Footer, SiteScripts. src/pages/index.astro is now a concise composition layer. Production Astro build passes.

Configured GitHub Pages project deployment for Nuvanta-Energy/nuvantaenergy.github.io: Astro site https://nuvanta-energy.github.io and base /nuvantaenergy.github.io, GitHub Actions workflow in .github/workflows/deploy.yml builds main, contact endpoint is PUBLIC_CONTACT_API_URL (separate API required because Pages cannot run Netlify Functions). Build passes.
